verdict.rationale: cubic offers natural-language interaction points for troubleshooting issues it finds—asking chat to 'tour this PR', replying to review comments for clarification, adding code to AI chat with diff/codebase context, and using its MCP server to 'triage PR or codebase scan issues'—but these are scoped to reviewing/understanding PR-flagged issues rather than general-purpose debugging (e.g., runtime errors, stack traces, logs). Missing for 10: evidence of NL-driven runtime/error debugging, log or stack-trace analysis, and independent validation that these chat features effectively resolve real bugs (community comments note high false-positive/irrelevant-comment rates for review tools in this space).
